limitations: Candidate counts and track counts are not ground-truth accuracy.
Torso colors and detector ReID cannot establish same-team player identity.
No hidden positions are filled; gaps and out-of-view frames have no coordinates.
Weight training provenance beyond the recorded source card and SHA is not independently verified.
alias_definition: Tentative common-frame seeds with conservative fragment suggestions; unresolved tracks are unassigned.

presentation.reset_at: missing observations, cuts, track/binding/source changes and manual anchors

presentation_geometry_comparison.metric: absolute deviation from time-linear neighboring observed foot-bottom positions
presentation_geometry_comparison.interpretation: presentation motion residual; includes real player/camera motion; not tracking or ground-position accuracy
